name: Nonomura Byouin no Hitobito
source:
The principal owner of the Nonomura Hospital has died and private investigator Kaibara must investigate. His nose smells something fishy, however, and his instincts are running amock amidst all the beautiful nurses in the hospital's employ. The answer is right in front of him. And all he needs to do for himself and the case is to feel his way through every girl's panties...

[Taken from [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=3380]ANN[/url]]
translation:
野野村医院的院长兼所有者突然身亡，私家侦探海原受命调查此案。他嗅到其中似乎另有隐情，而面对医院里众多美丽护士，他的直觉也开始肆意奔走。答案其实就在眼前。为了自己，也为了查明案件，他只需亲手探进每个女孩的内裤，一路摸索下去…

[摘自[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=3380]ANN[/url]]
